title: Cinnamon Apple Pull-Apart Rolls
changes_from_base: Muffin-tin rolls made of cinnamon-sugar coated dough pieces layered with diced apple, with a thin icing glaze.
summary: Little pull-apart rolls built from cinnamon-sugar coated dough pieces and juicy diced apple, baked in muffin cases and drizzled with icing.
equipment: large bowl or stand mixer with dough hook
cling film or a clean tea towel

ingredients.item: eating apple, cored and cut into 1 cm dice
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Dough
steps.text: Put everything for the dough in a large bowl and mix, then knead 8-10 min, until soft and smooth. It feels firm at first but loosens as you work it.

steps.title: Rise
steps.text: Cover and leave 1-1 1/2 h, until clearly puffy; it need not double.

steps.title: Cases
steps.text: Put 16 paper cases in the muffin tins and grease them lightly. Stir the sugar and cinnamon together in a small bowl.

steps.title: Cut
steps.text: Tip the dough out, divide it into 16 pieces of about 45 g and flatten each into a disc. Cut each disc into 8 small wedges.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Roll the wedges in the cinnamon sugar and drop 4 into each case, scatter over some apple and raisins, then top with 4 more wedges. Sprinkle any leftover cinnamon sugar on top.

steps.title: Prove and bake
steps.text: Cover and leave 45-60 min, until risen above the cases. Heat the oven to 190 °C (170 °C fan) and bake 20-24 min, until golden and the sugar is bubbling; the centre reads 88-90 °C.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Whisk the icing sugar, milk and salt until smooth and drizzle over the rolls once they have cooled for 10 min.

tips: Choose a firm eating apple that keeps some bite after baking.
Use paper cases; the melted sugar sticks fiercely to bare tins.
Let them cool a little before glazing or the icing simply runs off.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Best on the day. Keep in an airtight box for up to 2 days; warm at 160 °C for 5 min. Freeze unglazed for up to 1 month.
